name: Adversary Emulation
description: Full-scope emulation of a known threat actor's TTPs against your environment.
primary_objectives: Demonstrate whether the emulated adversary's attack path is viable in the target environment
Validate detection and response against historically observed TTPs

name: Purple Team Exercise
description: Collaborative red/blue validation focused on detection coverage and SOC workflow.
primary_objectives: Validate detection rules and alert fidelity for planned techniques
Measure SOC triage and escalation workflow under simulated adversary activity
secondary_objectives: Score detection coverage per ATT&CK technique
default_constraints_prohibited: Unannounced activity outside purple team window

name: Ransomware Readiness
description: Assess blast radius, lateral movement paths, and backup/recovery resilience without deploying ransomware.
primary_objectives: Map viable paths from initial access to domain-wide impact
Validate backup integrity and recovery procedures under simulated pressure
secondary_objectives: Test segmentation controls between business units

name: Cloud Identity Assessment
description: Hybrid identity abuse — from workstation compromise to privileged cloud access.
primary_objectives: Demonstrate whether workstation compromise leads to privileged cloud access
Validate Conditional Access, PIM, and cloud audit logging

name: Insider Threat Simulation
description: Authorized insider abuse of legitimate access — no external initial access required.
primary_objectives: Evaluate whether a trusted insider can reach sensitive data without triggering alerts
Validate DLP, UEBA, and access review controls
default_constraints_prohibited: Actual data exfiltration to external systems

name: Supply Chain Trust Validation
description: Assess trust boundaries with vendors, CI/CD pipelines, and third-party integrations.
primary_objectives: Validate whether compromised vendor access can reach internal critical assets
secondary_objectives: Assess software signing and artifact verification

name: Data Exfiltration Path Assessment
description: Map and test data collection and exfiltration paths without moving real sensitive data.
primary_objectives: Identify viable data staging and exfiltration channels from a compromised position
Validate DLP, proxy, and network monitoring effectiveness
default_constraints_prohibited: Real sensitive data leaving the environment

name: Assumed Breach Exercise
description: Start from an assumed compromised workstation — skip initial access, focus on post-exploitation.
primary_objectives: Evaluate post-compromise detection and containment from assumed foothold
Map privilege escalation and lateral movement paths
secondary_objectives: Test network segmentation under active adversary simulation
